svg.title: Make your notes stand out. — Callout Studio
svg.desc: The Three Callout Types appears as the note's inline title above a real Idea callout shown as a heading, inline phrase, and block, rendered through the plugin's actual reading processors, icon painter, and generated styles. Production components in phone layout with synthetic content on a purple promotional background, without a simulated Obsidian workspace. Mobile store artwork, 900 by 1600 pixels.

text.font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
